brief: Người đặt đồ ăn vặt và thức uống ở Việt Nam, chủ yếu thao tác trên điện thoại; có thể là khách vãng lai, khách đăng nhập hoặc nhân viên admin.

topics.who: Who they are: age range, region, languages, reading level, devices and network
topics.context: Where and how they use it: how often, how long, one hand or two, light, noise, interruptions
topics.apps: The apps they already use every day, and the patterns those apps have taught them
topics.expectations: What they expect and what frustrates them: reviews, forums, complaints, published studies
topics.preferences: Preferences that touch design: text size, dark mode, density, colour meanings in their culture
topics.accessibility: Access needs common in the group: vision, motor, hearing, cognitive, situational
topics.market: The market: the analogous product, what people would use instead, what those products all do, and the gap
